Standard arguments suggest that its low-energy physics is described by the $\mathbb{CP}^2$ nonlinear sigma model at $\theta=\pi$. Using the Bethe ansatz, we show that its low-energy excitations can be interpreted as deconfined domain walls, just as in the sigma model. However, the lattice model is integrable, whereas the field theory is generally believed not to be. We propose a solution to this mystery by finding an integrable field theory with the same low-energy limit but which is not Lorentz invariant. The integrability-preserving scaling limit is obtained by adding a higher conserved charge and tuning the chain to criticality. The gap closes quadratically, so that the limit must be described by some nonrelativistic field theory rather than the relativistic sigma model. We describe the two-particle scattering matrix of this field theory.
summary: 反铁磁双二次自旋 1 链是有间隙的、$SU(3)$ 对称且可积。标准论证表明，其低能物理由 $\theta=\pi$ 处的 $\mathbb{CP}^2$ 非线性 sigma 模型描述。使用 Bethe ansatz，我们表明它的低能激发可以解释为解除限制的畴壁，就像 sigma 模型一样。然而，晶格模型是可积的，而场论通常被认为不是可积的。我们通过寻找具有相同低能量极限但不是洛伦兹不变的可积场论来解决这个谜团。通过添加更高的守恒电荷并将链调整到临界点来获得可积保持的缩放限制。差距以二次方的方式缩小，因此极限必须用某种非相对论场论而不是相对论西格玛模型来描述。我们描述了该场论的双粒子散射矩阵。

title: Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation
abstract: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals. To demonstrate this, we continuously deform a broad class of two-band lattice models into decoupled chains, without closing the bulk gap or breaking the inversion symmetry, where the dislocation charge follows from a count of occupied bonds. Notably, the fractional part of this charge is insensitive to local perturbations of the dislocation core, and it therefore persists after the in-gap core state is removed, as we show analytically in the chain limit and numerically away from it. In the Weyl-semimetal counterpart, the response to a magnetic flux separates this crystalline charge from the charge set by the Chern number of each momentum slice. We propose that a half-integer core charge that persists after the in-gap peak disappears from the local spectrum can be detected in artificial electronic and optical lattices, with metamaterials providing complementary access to the core modes.
summary:
具有相反陈数的能带反转会抵消霍尔响应，并产生可能出现间隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，缺乏对在这种取消后仍然存在的拓扑的批量探测。我们在这里表明，具有抵消能带反转的反演对称双能带晶体中的位错结合了半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体实现的以键为中心的受阻原子极限的量子化体极化。为了证明这一点，我们不断地将一大类双能带晶格模型变形为解耦链，而不关闭体能隙或破坏反演对称性，其中位错电荷来自占据键的计数。值得注意的是，该电荷的小数部分对位错核心的局部扰动不敏感，因此在带隙核心状态被移除后它仍然存在，正如我们在链极限中分析并在数值上远离它所示。在外尔半金属对应物中，对磁通量的响应将该晶体电荷与每个动量切片的陈数所设置的电荷分开。

我们提出，在带隙内峰值从局部光谱中消失后，可以在人造电子和光学晶格中检测到持续存在的半整数核心电荷，其中超材料提供了对核心模式的补充访问。

title: Coupling of TQFTs to QFTs and SymTFT interfaces from bordisms
abstract: M-theory local models may exhibit torsional cycles and other non-trivial topology which interpolate between quantum field theory sectors localized at singularities and the asymptotic regions of the local model. We show that such structures give rise, in standard decoupling limits, to additional topological sectors which can couple non-trivially to the localized QFT. From a symmetry topological field theory (SymTFT) perspective, the physical boundary conditions associated to such local models are modified. We give a construction of SymTFT interfaces from geometric bordisms interpolating between the local singularity and the asymptotic boundary. We apply this construction to the circle compactification of a frozen $D_5$ singularity, identifying a topological interface between the $\mathbb{Z}_4$ SymTFT of the full theory and the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ SymTFT of its local $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ gauge sector. We show that the resulting coupling between the gauge theory and an additional topological quantum field theory accounts for the apparent mismatch between electric and magnetic symmetries of the frozen theory.
summary: M 理论局部模型可能会表现出扭转循环和其他非平凡的拓扑，这些拓扑在位于奇点处的量子场论扇区和局部模型的渐近区域之间进行插值。我们表明，这种结构在标准解耦极限内产生了额外的拓扑扇区，这些扇区可以与局部 QFT 进行非平凡的耦合。从对称拓扑场论（SymTFT）的角度来看，与此类局部模型相关的物理边界条件被修改。我们通过在局部奇点和渐近边界之间插值的几何棱柱给出了 SymTFT 接口的构造。我们将此构造应用于冻结 $D_5$ 奇点的圆紧致化，识别完整理论的 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ SymTFT 与其局部 $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ 规范扇区的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ SymTFT 之间的拓扑界面。我们证明规范理论和附加拓扑量子场理论之间产生的耦合解释了冻结理论的电对称性和磁对称性之间的明显不匹配。

title: Scherk-Schwarz Compactifications: From Circles to Strings
abstract: This review is written with a simple question in mind: what does one need to know to enter the literature on Scherk-Schwarz compactifications? It is organized as a sequence of questions that a graduate student might naturally ask, together with the concepts, calculations, and formal tools needed to work through the literature. The discussion starts at an elementary field-theory level and gradually develops toward more advanced aspects of supergravity, orbifolds, quantum effects, and string theory. Phenomenological applications are deliberately left aside.
summary: 这篇评论是带着一个简单的问题写的：要进入 Scherk-Schwarz 紧化文献，需要知道什么？它被组织成研究生可能自然会问的一系列问题，以及研究文献所需的概念、计算和正式工具。讨论从基本的场论层面开始，逐渐发展到超引力、轨道折叠、量子效应和弦理论等更高级的方面。现象学的应用被故意搁置一边。

title: Quiver-Invariant Triality between Brane Brick Models
abstract: We study quiver-invariant triality between 2d (0,2) supersymmetric gauge theories described by brane brick models associated with toric Calabi-Yau 4-folds. The dual theories share the same gauge groups, field content and E-terms but have distinct J-terms. We present an explicit pair of such brane brick models and identify the sequence of triality mutations relating them. This sequence returns the quiver to its original form while transforming the J- and E-terms. We explain the relation between quiver-invariant triality and the orbifold reduction of quiver-invariant brane tilings.
summary: 我们研究了由与 toric Calabi-Yau 4 倍相关的膜砖模型描述的 2d (0,2) 超对称规范理论之间的颤动不变试验。双理论共享相同的规范组、场内容和 E 项，但具有不同的 J 项。我们提出了一对明确的膜砖模型，并确定了与它们相关的三性突变序列。此序列将箭袋恢复到其原始形式，同时转换 J 项和 E 项。我们解释了颤动不变的三重性和颤动不变膜平铺的环倍减少之间的关系。

title: Asymmetric Orbifolds and 4-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ String Islands
abstract: We formulate heterotic and type II $\mathbb T^6/\mathbb Z_n$ asymmetric orbifolds preserving all 16 right-moving supersymmetries and leading to 4-dimensional islands without massless moduli other than the dilaton. We establish the consistency of the orbifold conformal field theory, including the validity of operator interpretation. In the heterotic case we classify all islands based on the $\Gamma(22,6)$ lattice constructed via the Leech lattice. In the type II case we also provide a classification of allowed $\Gamma(6,6)$ lattices and orbifold generators. In both cases we further examine whether a particular orbifold admits an archipelago of different islands arising from inequivalent realizations of the orbifold action.
summary: 我们制定了杂变和 II 型 $\mathbb T^6/\mathbb Z_n$ 不对称轨道折叠，保留了所有 16 个右移超对称性，并导致除了膨胀之外没有无质量模量的 4 维岛。我们建立了轨道共形场理论的一致性，包括算子解释的有效性。在杂种优势情况下，我们根据通过 Leech 晶格构建的 $\Gamma(22,6)$ 晶格对所有岛屿进行分类。在类型 II 的情况下，我们还提供了允许的 $\Gamma(6,6)$ 格和轨道生成器的分类。在这两种情况下，我们进一步检查特定的环折是否承认由不同岛屿组成的群岛是由于环折动作的不等价实现而产生的。

title: Conformal manifolds of $\mathcal{N}=1$ orbifold theories - Part I: Marginal deformations and the one-loop spectrum
abstract: We consider orbifolds of 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory that preserve minimal supersymmetry and study their conformal manifolds, focusing on two families of Abelian orbifolds in the planar limit. We compute their superconformal indices, construct their complete single-trace BPS spectra and identify the conformal manifolds. These are generically spanned by a subset of the gauge-couplings, whose number we derive from both gauge and string theory, and a universal Leigh--Strassler-type superpotential deformation. We then construct the complete, planar one-loop dilatation operator on these conformal manifolds, giving perturbative access to the full non-BPS spectrum away from the orbifold point. This lays the groundwork for studying special loci of the conformal manifold in a forthcoming Part II.
summary: 我们考虑保留最小超对称性的 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨米尔斯理论的轨道折叠并研究它们的共形流形，重点关注平面极限中的两个阿贝尔轨道折叠。我们计算它们的超共形指数，构建完整的单迹 BPS 谱并识别共形流形。这些通常由规范耦合的子集（其数量我们从规范理论和弦理论中得出）和通用的利-斯特拉斯勒型超势变形跨越。然后，我们在这些共形流形上构造完整的平面单环膨胀算子，从而可以微扰地访问远离轨道折叠点的完整非 BPS 谱。这为即将到来的第二部分中研究共形流形的特殊轨迹奠定了基础。

title: Stringy Corrections from Gravity: Predictions for BFSS and ABJM
abstract: Despite enormous progress in string theory, the leading stringy corrections to many holographic observables remain unknown. String/M-theory dualities nonetheless allow them to be determined from gravity alone. From the winding modes of one-loop 11d supergravity on a circle, we derive the leading tree-level stringy terms in the type IIA effective action for the metric, dilaton, and Ramond--Ramond one-form, in closed form as a finite supertrace over Lorentz generators. On the thermal D0-brane geometry, this gives the first correction to the low-temperature thermodynamics of the BFSS matrix model. Its coefficient differs from published lattice Monte Carlo estimates by $\approx 20\%$. With the four-form flux included, the same method reproduces the $\zeta(3)k^{2}$ term of the ABJM free energy on the three-sphere obtained by localization.
summary: 尽管弦理论取得了巨大进展，但对许多全息可观测量的主要弦修正仍然未知。尽管如此，弦/M 理论的二元性仍然允许它们仅由引力来确定。从圆上单环 11d 超重力的缠绕模式，我们导出了度量、膨胀和拉蒙德-拉蒙德一式的 IIA 型有效作用中的主要树级弦项，其封闭形式为洛伦兹发生器上的有限超迹。在热 D0 膜几何结构上，这对 BFSS 矩阵模型的低温热力学进行了首次修正。其系数与已发布的格蒙特卡罗估计值相差 $\approx\%$。在包含四种形式的通量的情况下，相同的方法再现了通过定位获得的三球体上ABJM自由能的$\zeta(3)k^{2}$项。

title: Actionless Branes on Axion Wormholes
abstract: Can a Euclidean axion wormhole extend to infinity with every instanton still suppressed? The imaginary distance bound says it cannot: some instanton must become actionless first. Calabi-Yau compactifications appear to violate the bound: several axions share the field excursion, and the instantons charged under any one of them stay suppressed all the way. We show that the wormhole can hide from these instantons but not from their bound states: misaligned central charges make a bound state cheaper than its constituents, while the axions act on every constituent. On the type IIB wormhole supported by two axions of the Neveu-Schwarz two-form, a fivebrane carrying string charge becomes actionless at large volume within two thirds of the way to infinity, for either relative sign of the axions and however they share the excursion. In S-dual variables it is a D5-brane with magnetic flux for one sign and a D5-NS5 bound state for the other. Adding more axions does not help: the same branes become actionless on every Calabi-Yau threefold, because what counts is the degree of homogeneity of the saxion sector, not the number of axions. These bound states are what the convex-hull axion weak gravity conjecture requires.
summary:
欧几里得轴子虫洞能否在每个瞬子仍受到抑制的情况下延伸至无穷大？想象的距离界限说它不能：某些瞬子必须首先变得无动作。卡拉比-丘紧化似乎违反了界限：几个轴子共享场偏移，并且在其中任何一个轴子下充电的瞬子始终受到抑制。我们证明，虫洞可以隐藏这些瞬时子，但不能隐藏它们的束缚态：未对准的中心电荷使束缚态比其成分更便宜，而轴子作用于每个成分。在由 Neveu-Schwarz 两种形式的两个轴子支撑的 IIB 型虫洞上，对于轴子的任一相对符号以及无论如何共享偏移，携带弦电荷的五膜在到无穷大的三分之二内的大体积下变得无作用。在 S-对偶变量中，它是一个 D5 膜，一个符号具有磁通量，另一个符号具有 D5-NS5 束缚态。添加更多的轴子并没有帮助：相同的膜在每个卡拉比-丘三倍上变得无作用，因为重要的是萨克子扇区的同质程度，而不是轴子的数量。

这些束缚态正是凸包轴子弱引力猜想所需要的。

title: Twist and Shout: defect lines on the Rényi torus
abstract: We consider what the entanglement between two regions of a critical system can reveal about its symmetries, including non-invertible ones. For two intervals in a two-dimensional conformal field theory, the second Rényi entropy is a partition function on a torus, and a topological defect line can be wrapped around one of the intervals. For an on-site symmetry this computes the overlap of the reduced density matrix with its image under the symmetry acting on one interval, and in general it defines an observable that depends only on the cross-ratio. As the intervals approach each other, the observable vanishes at a rate set by the lightest operator on which the line can end, and its monodromy is fixed by the spins of such operators. Since these spins are constrained by the fusion category, the observable detects 't Hooft anomalies and distinguishes categories with the same fusion rules. It can be computed in closed form for a $\mathbb{Z}_2$, a $\mathbb{Z}_3$ and a Fibonacci line of the $(E_8)_1$ theory, and for the spin-flip and Kramers-Wannier lines of the Ising model, where the spin-flip result agrees with an exact computation in the critical Ising chain. Averaged over a symmetry, the observable reduces to a known Jones-index bound on the mutual information. We also show that the associated twist-field crossing equations are a form of the modular bootstrap, and discuss whether the full fusion category can be recovered from entanglement on surfaces of higher genus.
summary:
我们考虑关键系统的两个区域之间的纠缠可以揭示其对称性，包括不可逆对称性。对于二维共形场论中的两个区间，第二个 Rényi 熵是环面上的配分函数，并且拓扑缺陷线可以缠绕在其中一个区间上。对于现场对称性，这会计算约化密度矩阵与其图像在作用于一个区间的对称性下的重叠，并且一般来说，它定义了一个仅依赖于交比的可观测量。当间隔彼此接近时，可观察到的消失速度由最轻的算子设定，该算子可以在该速度上结束，并且其单峰性由这些算子的自旋固定。由于这些自旋受到融合类别的约束，因此可观察到的可检测到 't Hooft 异常并区分具有相同融合规则的类别。它可以以封闭形式计算 $\mathbb{Z}_2$、$\mathbb{Z}_3$ 和 $(E_8)_1$ 理论的斐波那契线，以及伊辛模型的自旋翻转和 Kramers-Wannier 线，其中自旋翻转结果与临界伊辛链中的精确计算一致。

在对称性上进行平均，可观察到的互信息减少到已知的琼斯指数界限。我们还证明了相关的扭转场交叉方程是模块化引导的一种形式，并讨论了是否可以从更高属表面上的纠缠中恢复完全融合类别。

title: Entanglement entropy from fundamental strings
abstract: In previous work, we derived the local entropy capacity from off-shell string theory and combined it with the gravitational replica construction and flow-cut duality to normalize the entropy flow carried by physical fundamental strings. In this paper, we apply this framework to interval entanglement in holographic CFT$_2$. We construct explicit on-shell F1 worldsheets in the AdS$_3$ vacuum and planar BTZ, derive their Kalb-Ramond source currents, and show that the normalized spatial currents saturate the corresponding RT surface. Their flux reproduces both the vacuum single interval entropy and the finite temperature CFT$_2$ result. We then vary the NS-NS flux fraction. Although the total maximal flux remains unchanged, the F1 equations continuously redistribute the strings among different parts of the complement. In planar BTZ, the resulting signed flux through the bifurcation line reproduces the extensive thermal entropy and can vanish in the pure NS-NS limit without changing the interval entropy. Thus the on-shell string dynamics additionally determines its physical routing and boundary contact structure.
summary: 在之前的工作中，我们从离壳弦理论推导了局域熵容量，并将其与引力复制结构和流割对偶性相结合，对物理基本弦携带的熵流进行归一化。在本文中，我们将该框架应用于全息 CFT$_2$ 中的区间纠缠。我们在 AdS$_3$ 真空和平面 BTZ 中构造显式壳上 F1 世界表，推导出它们的 Kalb-Ramond 源电流，并表明归一化空间电流使相应的 RT 表面饱和。它们的通量再现了真空单区间熵和有限温度 CFT$_2$ 结果。 We then vary the NS-NS flux fraction.尽管总最大通量保持不变，F1 方程不断地在补码的不同部分之间重新分配字符串。在平面 BTZ 中，通过分叉线产生的带符号通量再现了广泛的热熵，并且可以在纯 NS-NS 极限中消失，而不改变区间熵。因此，壳上弦动力学还决定了其物理路线和边界接触结构。

title: $C_T$ and $C_J$ of general scalar--fermion conformal field theories in $d=4-ε$
abstract: We compute $C_T$ and $C_J$, the coefficients of the stress-tensor and conserved-current two-point functions, to order $\epsilon^3$ at any fixed point of the general renormalizable theory of scalars and fermions in $d=4-\epsilon$. We give explicit results for the chiral Ising, XY and Heisenberg models and for fixed points with emergent supersymmetry in $d=3$. In theories without a four-dimensional counterpart, fermion loops with an odd number of Yukawa vertices contribute at order $\epsilon^3$ through traces whose continuation away from $d=3$ is ambiguous; we fix it with $\mathcal N=1$ supersymmetry, by computing the two-point functions of the supercurrent and of the fermionic partner of a flavor current to four loops. In $d=3$, Padé approximants closely reproduce the exact $C_T$ of the $\mathcal N=2$ super-Ising model. We estimate the universal conductivity at the charge-density-wave, Kekulé and Néel transitions of graphene to be $\sigma/\sigma_{\rm free}\approx0.91$, $0.79$--$0.83$ and $0.64$--$0.74$, and show that the exact conductivity at the supersymmetric transition on the surface of a topological insulator is $\sigma/\sigma_{\rm free}=\frac{9}{10}\,C_T/C_{T,\rm free}\approx0.654$, $10\%$ below the value previously reported.
summary:
我们计算 $C_T$ 和 $C_J$（应力张量和守恒电流两点函数的系数），以在 $d=4-\epsilon$ 中标量和费米子的一般可重整化理论的任何固定点处对 $\epsilon^3$ 进行排序。我们给出了手性 Ising、XY 和 Heisenberg 模型以及 $d=3$ 中具有新兴超对称性的固定点的明确结果。在没有四维对应物的理论中，具有奇数个 Yukawa 顶点的费米子环通过轨迹以 $\epsilon^3$ 阶贡献，而轨迹从 $d=3$ 开始的延续是不明确的；我们用 $\mathcal N=1$ 超对称性来修复它，通过计算四个循环的超电流和风味电流的费米子伙伴的两点函数。在 $d=3$ 中，Padé 近似近似再现了 $\mathcal N=2$ super-Ising 模型的精确 $C_T$。

我们估计石墨烯电荷密度波、Kekulé 和 Néel 跃迁处的通用电导率为 $\sigma/\sigma_{\rm free}\approx0.91$、$0.79$--$0.83$ 和 $0.64$--$0.74$，并表明拓扑绝缘体表面超对称跃迁处的精确电导率为$\sigma/\sigma_{\rm free}=\frac{9}{10}\,C_T/C_{T,\rm free}\approx0.654$，比之前报告的值低$10\%$。

title: Nonzero cubic Love numbers of Schwarzschild black holes
abstract: Static Love numbers of Schwarzschild black holes vanish at linear and quadratic order in General Relativity, while generic nonlinear tides remain less understood. We solve a specific non-axisymmetric octupolar tide at cubic order and, building on the symmetry of static General Relativity exploited by Parra-Martinez and Podo, match the result to a worldline effective field theory (EFT) using dimensional regularization. Surprisingly, we find a Love number that neither vanishes nor runs.
summary: 在广义相对论中，史瓦西黑洞的静态洛夫数在线性和二次阶上消失，而一般的非线性潮汐仍然知之甚少。我们求解了立方阶的特定非轴对称八极潮汐，并以 Parra-Martinez 和 Podo 利用的静态广义相对论的对称性为基础，使用维度正则化将结果与世界有效场论 (EFT) 相匹配。令人惊讶的是，我们发现了一个既不消失也不运行的洛夫数。

title: Soft Factorisation of WQFT and the Spinning 4PM Magnusian
abstract: We derive the soft divergences of $\hat{N}=-i\log\hat{S}$ in the Worldline Quantum Field Theory (WQFT) formalism, focusing on poles due to single massive-massive (Coulomb) and massive-massless (tail) graviton exchanges. Our derivation is inspired by the Faddeev-Kulish procedure, switching the interaction picture to one with an infrared-finite $\hat{N}$-matrix. Soft divergences emerging from the worldline are correlators of Wilson lines. As confirmation of this structure, we demonstrate explicitly how divergences of inclusive observables including the momentum impulse $\Delta p_i^\mu$ and spin kick $\Delta S_i^\mu$ cancel, and we reproduce the infrared divergence of the one-loop scattering waveform. Using the Magnus series representation of $\hat{N}$ and Murua coefficients, we then calculate the Magnusian $N=\langle0|\hat{N}|0\rangle$ at fourth post-Minkowskian (4PM) order, including linear-in-spin corrections. For aligned spins, $-\partial N/\partial L$ reproduces the full scattering angle through 3PM order; at 4PM order, $N$ develops a soft divergence as predicted by our soft factorisation. Using the Feynman $i0^+$ prescription, we also derive an infrared-finite 4PM Magnusian which compactly encodes existing results for the conservative momentum impulse and spin kick via nested iterations of Poisson brackets.
summary:
我们在世界线量子场论（WQFT）形式主义中推导出 $\hat{N}=-i\log\hat{S}$ 的软散度，重点关注由于单个质量-质量（库仑）和质量-无质量（尾部）引力子交换而产生的极点。我们的推导受到 Faddeev-Kulish 过程的启发，将交互图切换为具有红外有限 $\hat{N}$ 矩阵的图。世界线出现的软分歧是威尔逊线的相关因素。作为对这一结构的确认，我们明确地证明了包括动量脉冲 $\Delta p_i^\mu$ 和自旋踢 $\Delta S_i^\mu$ 在内的包容性可观测量的发散是如何抵消的，并且我们重现了单环散射波形的红外发散。使用 $\hat{N}$ 和 Murua 系数的马格努斯级数表示，然后计算第四后明可夫斯基 (4PM) 阶的马格努斯 $N=\langle0|\hat{N}|0\rangle$，包括线性自旋校正。对于对齐自旋，$-\partial N/\partial L$ 通过 3PM 顺序再现全散射角；在下午 4 点，$N$ 出现软背离，正如我们的软分解所预测的那样。

使用 Feynman $i0^+$ 处方，我们还推导出红外有限 4PM 马格努斯矩阵，它通过泊松括号的嵌套迭代对保守动量脉冲和旋转踢的现有结果进行紧凑编码。

title: Calabi-Yau linear models with abelian bundles
abstract: We introduce a construction of (0,2) gauged linear sigma models whose large radius phases realize Calabi-Yau sigma models with line bundles. We study a family of such models admitting Landau-Ginzburg orbifold phases, described as asymmetric orbifolds of (2,2) Gepner models and free left-moving fermions. These orbifolds extend the Gepner construction to a broader class of (0,2) SCFTs, and reveal unexpected features, including the emergence of free fermions in twisted sectors and substantial enhancements of the left-moving current algebra. The gauged linear sigma model connects the Calabi-Yau geometry to these rational points, where the volume modulus becomes charged under the enhanced gauge symmetry and freezes at the string scale.
summary: 我们引入了 (0,2) 规范线性 sigma 模型的构造，其大半径相位实现了具有线束的 Calabi-Yau sigma 模型。我们研究了一系列允许兰道-金兹堡轨道折叠相的模型，这些模型被描述为 (2,2) 格普纳模型和自由左移费米子的不对称轨道折叠。这些轨道折叠将格普纳构造扩展到更广泛的 (0,2) SCFT 类别，并揭示了意想不到的特征，包括扭曲扇区中自由费米子的出现以及左移电流代数的显着增强。规范线性西格玛模型将 Calabi-Yau 几何结构连接到这些有理点，其中体积模量在增强的规范对称性下充电并在弦尺度上冻结。

title: From Instantons to AdS Boundaries: Tracing the Geometric Path from Quantum Anomalies to Massive Gravity
abstract: This thesis studies how boundary data enter two gravitational observables: the Dirac index on gravitational instantons and conserved charges in three-dimensional New Massive Gravity. In Einstein gravity coupled to ModMax electrodynamics, we compute the index of charged Dirac fermions on Taub-NUT and Eguchi-Hanson instantons using the Atiyah-Patodi-Singer theorem, which includes the spectral asymmetry of the boundary Dirac operator. The Taub-NUT index agrees with the Maxwell result. For Eguchi-Hanson, the gauge-field contribution to the axial anomaly depends explicitly on the ModMax parameter when expressed in terms of the solution parameters. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter solutions of New Massive Gravity with Brown-Henneaux boundary conditions, a term linear in the extrinsic curvature reproduces the holographic stress tensor of the auxiliary-field formulation. At the degenerate point, relaxed boundary conditions admit an additional constrained Fefferman-Graham coefficient. A quadratic extrinsic counterterm cancels the residual power divergence. We derive the boundary Ward identity and show that the holographic and Noether-Wald charges agree for the solutions studied.
summary: 本论文研究边界数据如何进入两个引力可观测量：引力瞬子的狄拉克指数和三维新大引力中的守恒电荷。在与 ModMax 电动力学耦合的爱因斯坦引力中，我们使用 Atiyah-Patodi-Singer 定理计算 Taub-NUT 和 Eguchi-Hanson 瞬时子上带电狄拉克费米子的指数，其中包括边界狄拉克算子的谱不对称性。 Taub-NUT 指数与 Maxwell 结果一致。对于 Eguchi-Hanson，当以解参数表示时，规范场对轴向异常的贡献明确取决于 ModMax 参数。对于具有 Brown-Henneaux 边界条件的新大引力的渐近反德西特解，外在曲率中的线性项再现了辅助场公式的全息应力张量。在简并点，宽松的边界条件允许附加约束 Fefferman-Graham 系数。二次外部反项消除了剩余功率发散。我们推导出边界 Ward 恒等式，并表明全息电荷和 Noether-Wald 电荷与所研究的解决方案一致。

title: Holographic Duals of $SL^{(q)}(2, \mathbb{R})$ Deformed CFTs
abstract: We study the holographic bulk dual of 2D CFTs evolved by $sl^{(q)}(2,R)$-deformed Hamiltonians. Working in the Hamiltonian-adapted frame, in which the $sl^{(q)}(2,R)$-deformed effective Floquet Hamiltonian generates time translations, we construct the dual Bañados geometries for the three distinct classes of dynamics: the heating phase, the non-heating phase and the phase boundary. Specifically, we show that in the heating phase, the bulk patch dual to the region between two neighbouring fixed points has a time-dependent causal horizon and asymptotes to a static AdS Rindler geometry at late times, while the non-heating phase has no horizon. We discuss how the late-time behaviour of the entanglement entropy, particularly its linear growth in the heating phase, can be understood from the bulk in two different ways: in global AdS, from the portion of the geodesic behind the horizons, and in a quotient description, from an effective shockwave produced by a boosted conical defect. Finally, for ($q=1$), we complete the holographic analysis of Ref. [1] by reproducing the exact CFT expression of the OTOC from the bulk and explaining why it exhibits an exponential growth {\it only} when the operators lie on the side of the two fixed points.
summary:
我们研究由 $sl^{(q)}(2,R)$ 变形哈密顿量演化而来的 2D CFT 的全息体对偶。在哈密顿量适应框架中工作，其中 $sl^{(q)}(2,R)$ 变形的有效 Floquet 哈密顿量生成时间平移，我们为三种不同的动力学类别构建了对偶 Bañados 几何：加热阶段、非加热阶段和相边界。具体来说，我们表明，在加热阶段，与两个相邻固定点之间的区域对偶的体块具有依赖于时间的因果范围，并在后期渐近于静态 AdS Rindler 几何，而非加热阶段没有范围。我们讨论了如何从整体上以两种不同的方式理解纠缠熵的后期行为，特别是其在加热阶段的线性增长：在全局 AdS 中，从地平线后面的测地线部分，以及在商描述中，从增强的圆锥形缺陷产生的有效冲击波。最后，对于($q=1$)，我们完成了Ref.的​​全息分析。

[1] 通过从整体中再现 OTOC 的精确 CFT 表达式，并解释为什么它在算子位于两个固定点一侧时表现出指数增长{\it only}。

title: Upper Bounds on the Radion Mass in a Warped Extra Dimension
abstract:
We study absolute upper bounds on the mass ratio $R_{11}=m_{r_1}/m_{h_1}$ between the radion ($r_1$) and graviton ($h_1$) lightest modes in five dimensional warped models. We consider warped models with an admissible singular behavior in the infrared: i.e.~models with power-like ($\sim  ar\phi^{2n}$) and with exponential ($\sim e^{2
u ar\phi}$) bulk potentials, where $ ar\phi$ is the stabilizing bulk field. We find a correlation between $R_{11}$ and the singular behavior of the Ricci scalar, which allows to establish an absolute upper bound on the former. For the power-like models, the maximum value of $R_{11}$ increases with $n$. In the limit $n	o\infty$, the power-like model reproduces the exponential model and reaches the same upper bound as the latter. For the exponential model, we derive analytically the bound $R_{11}<1$, with the largest value approached for the case $
u	o 1^+$ (where $
u=1$ corresponds to the linear dilaton model) and consistent with unitarity sum rules. For exponential models we also obtain the absolute upper bound on the second radion mode ratio $R_{21}=m_{r_2}/m_{h_1}\lesssim 1.374$. This value is reached for $
u=2$ when the IR brane approaches the singularity. For this configuration, we verify that the scalar contribution satisfies the unitarity sum rule when the complete radion Kaluza-Klein tower is included.
summary:
我们研究五维扭曲模型中射子 ($r_1$) 和引力子 ($h_1$) 最轻模式之间的质量比 $R_{11}=m_{r_1}/m_{h_1}$ 的绝对上限。我们考虑在红外中具有可接受的奇异行为的扭曲模型：即具有类似功率 ($\sim  ar\phi^{2n}$) 和指数 ($\sim e^{2
u ar\phi}$) 体势的模型，其中 $ ar\phi$ 是稳定体场。我们发现 $R_{11}$ 和 Ricci 标量的奇异行为之间存在相关性，这允许在前者上建立绝对上限。对于幂类模型，$R_{11}$ 的最大值随着$n$ 的增加而增加。在极限 $n	o\infty$ 下，类幂模型再现了指数模型，并达到了与后者相同的上限。对于指数模型，我们分析推导出边界$R_{11}<1$，最大值接近$
u\到1^+$的情况（其中$
u=1$对应于线性膨胀模型）并且符合幺正性和规则。对于指数模型，我们还获得第二射电模式比率 $R_{21}=m_{r_2}/m_{h_1}\lesssim 1.374$ 的绝对上限。

当 IR 膜接近奇点时，$
u=2$ 就达到该值。对于此配置，我们验证当包含完整的放射性 Kaluza-Klein 塔时，标量贡献满足幺正性和规则。

title: Pairwise fermionic mode correlations in electric and magnetic backgrounds: Landau-level structure and Schwinger production
abstract: We investigate mutual information and logarithmic negativity in fermionic Schwinger pair production in parallel electric and magnetic fields. Using spin-dependent Bogoliubov transformations, we construct the in-vacuum and derive the particle--antiparticle correlations for selected Landau modes. We also consider an initially entangled two-particle state and evaluate the correlations for six bipartitions. The physical Landau-level structure is treated explicitly by distinguishing modes with the same oscillator index from the spin representatives of a common physical Landau level. For matched higher levels, the pairwise redistribution relations retain the electric-only form, with the magnetic-field dependence entering through the Landau-level pair-production probabilities. When the two particle groups occupy different physical levels, the cross particle--antiparticle correlations become unequal, and we derive analytic relations characterizing this asymmetry. We further obtain the local logarithmic negativity from the ordinary partial transpose in a fixed occupation-space basis. Finally, we extend the analysis to a Sauter-type electric field in a constant magnetic background and examine the dependence of the pairwise correlations on the field parameters and Landau-level structure.
summary:
我们研究了平行电场和磁场中费米子施温格对产生的互信息和对数负性。使用自旋相关的 Bogoliubov 变换，我们构建了真空并导出了所选朗道模式的粒子-反粒子相关性。我们还考虑初始纠缠的双粒子状态并评估六个二分的相关性。通过将具有相同振荡器指数的模式与常见物理朗道能级的自旋代表区分开来显式地处理物理朗道能级结构。对于匹配的更高水平，成对再分配关系保留纯电形式，磁场依赖性通过朗道水平成对产生概率进入。当两个粒子群占据不同的物理层面时，粒子-反粒子之间的相关性变得不相等，我们推导出表征这种不对称性的解析关系。我们进一步从固定占据空间基础上的普通部分转置中获得局部对数负性。

最后，我们将分析扩展到恒定磁场背景下的索特型电场，并检查成对相关性对场参数和朗道能级结构的依赖性。

title: From Integrability to Chaos in Tensionless AdS3 String Theory
abstract: We study quantum-gravitational corrections to the planar integrable structure of the symmetric product orbifold $\text{Sym}^N(\mathbb{T}^4)$ that is dual to tensionless string theory on AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$. We consider the deformation that switches on R-R flux in the bulk, and analyze the associated level spacing statistics. The leading non-planar corrections lift the planar degeneracies and produce signs of random-matrix behavior. Our results provide a controlled example of string interactions driving the onset of quantum chaos.
summary: 我们研究对称积轨道折叠 $\text{Sym}^N(\mathbb{T}^4)$ 的平面可积结构的量子引力修正，该结构与 AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$ 上的无张力弦理论对偶。我们考虑在整体上开启 R-R 通量的变形，并分析相关的能级间距统计数据。主要的非平面校正提升了平面简并性并产生随机矩阵行为的迹象。我们的结果提供了驱动量子混沌发生的弦相互作用的受控示例。

title: A full-color four-point form factor
abstract: We determine the symbol and complete functions of the full-color two-loop four-point maximally helicity violating stress-tensor form factor in $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, including $N^1$ double traces and $N^0$ single traces. Numerical unitarity and a master-integral bootstrap fix the result. A direct form-factor bootstrap reproduces the symbol. Permuting external legs in the planar 88-letter alphabet yields all 79 letters, while the $N^0$ terms contain four new nonclassical contributions. We also obtain the complete $N^0$ two-loop triple-collinear hard splitting functions.
summary: 我们确定了$\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills理论中全色二环四点最大螺旋度破坏应力张量形状因子的符号和完整函数，包括$N^1$双迹线和$N^0$单迹线。数值幺正性和主积分引导程序修复了结果。直接形状因子引导程序可再现该符号。排列平面 88 个字母字母表中的外部腿会产生所有 79 个字母，而 $N^0$ 项包含四个新的非经典贡献。我们还获得了完整的$N^0$二环三共线硬分裂函数。

title: Two Faces of Spacetime Density Matrices: Entanglement and Complexity
abstract: We establish a direct connection between entanglement and complexity through spacetime density matrices. For stationary pure states and complementary regions at different times, spacetime replica moments encode the return amplitude of a replica-defect quench. This representation defines an associated state spread complexity, which we call Krylov-Rényi complexity. It can equivalently be obtained by using a replica-defect excitation of the replicated background state as the seed and evolving it under the original replicated Hamiltonian. We further construct Krylov-von Neumann complexity as a probe limit from first-order replica data. Timelike entanglement and complexity provide complementary information at a fixed time, while the full time dependence of the timelike entropy determines the Krylov dynamics and hence the complexity. The replica construction fixes the seed and its evolution through the background state, subsystem geometry, and regulator, without an independently chosen probe operator. Like entanglement entropy, the resulting complexity is defined nonperturbatively and probes universal properties and dynamical information about the underlying theory.
summary: 我们通过时空密度矩阵在纠缠和复杂性之间建立了直接联系。对于不同时间的静态纯态和互补区域，时空复制矩编码复制缺陷淬灭的返回幅度。该表示定义了关联的状态扩展复杂性，我们将其称为 Krylov-Rényi 复杂性。它可以等效地通过使用复制背景状态的复制缺陷激励作为种子并在原始复制哈密顿量下演化它来获得。我们进一步构造 Krylov-von Neumann 复杂度作为一阶副本数据的探测极限。类时纠缠和复杂性在固定时间提供补充信息，而类时熵的完全时间依赖性决定了克雷洛夫动力学，从而决定了复杂性。复制品结构通过背景状态、子系统几何结构和调节器来固定种子及其演化，而无需独立选择的探针操作员。与纠缠熵一样，所产生的复杂性是非微扰地定义的，并探讨有关基础理论的普遍性质和动态信息。

title: Second-order formulation of chiral fermions with a local boundary condition
abstract: Chiral fermions in $d$ dimensions arise naturally as boundary modes of a massive fermion in $d+1$ dimensions subject to a local boundary condition. When anomalies are absent, this construction can be used to define an intrinsically $d$-dimensional theory of chiral fermions. However, defining the path integral using the first-order Dirac operator with this boundary condition is technically inconvenient, even in the continuum. We present a formulation in terms of second-order differential operators that is completely equivalent to the original formulation in the continuum. Its natural lattice discretization generates Wilson's term and avoids fermion doubling. Our lattice formulation closely resembles the boundary-fermion construction of Shamir, and provides some insight into the case of a general Wilson parameter.
summary: $d$ 维度的手性费米子自然出现为受局部边界条件影响的 $d+1$ 维度的大质量费米子的边界模式。当不存在异常时，这种构造可用于定义本质上 $d$ 维手性费米子理论。然而，使用具有此边界条件的一阶狄拉克算子定义路径积分在技术上是不方便的，即使在连续体中也是如此。我们提出了一个二阶微分算子的公式，它与连续统中的原始公式完全等效。其自然晶格离散化产生威尔逊项并避免费米子倍增。我们的晶格公式与 Shamir 的边界费米子结构非常相似，并且提供了对一般威尔逊参数情况的一些见解。

title: Holographic Tessellations Tensor Networks $\{p,q\}$ from Entangled Quantum Tetrahedron in Loop Quantum Gravity
abstract: The relationship between spin network states in loop quantum gravity and bulk--boundary duality is further explored using the tessellated holographic tensor network. We develop a holographic tensor network construction based on quantum entanglement between tetrahedra in loop quantum gravity (LQG). This construction relates four-valent intertwiner spaces and Bell states dressed with $SU(2)$ holonomies to effective tensors on hyperbolic $\{p,q\}$ tessellations. For the $\{5,4\}$ tessellation, six tetrahedra are assembled into a single effective cell with five network legs and one logical index. Provided that the microscopic transfer map has full row rank, a right inverse and a completion on the kernel space are employed to construct an isometric embedding, yielding an effective tensor proportional to a perfect tensor. The construction is generalized to the $p=2n-1$ family, with local dimensions supporting absolutely maximally entangled states. On finite networks satisfying a radial orientation condition, an appropriate normalization produces an isometric bulk--boundary map. For cuts satisfying the isometry condition on both sides, the boundary entropy decomposes into a link contribution $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ and the bulk entropy, thereby providing a discrete realization of the quantum Ryu--Takayanagi structure. Applications to the black hole interior are formulated via postselection-based non-isometric encoding. Assuming additional Haar statistics, this framework is used to analyze the preservation of overlaps on average and the competition between entropy branches underlying the Page Curve. These results establish a constructive link between the geometric degrees of freedom of LQG and holographic codes, while clarifying the conditions required to connect them to geometric area in LQG, the location of the quantum extremal surface, and evaporation of black hole.
summary:
使用镶嵌全息张量网络进一步探讨了圈量子引力中的自旋网络状态与体边界二元性之间的关系。我们开发了一种基于环量子引力（LQG）中四面体之间的量子纠缠的全息张量网络结构。这种构造将四价交织空间和带有 $SU(2)$ 完整函数的贝尔态与双曲 $\{p,q\}$ 曲面细分上的有效张量联系起来。对于 $\{5,4\}$ 细分，六个四面体被组装成一个具有五个网络腿和一个逻辑索引的有效单元。假设微观传递图具有满行秩，则采用核空间上的右逆和补全来构造等距嵌入，产生与完美张量成比例的有效张量。该结构被推广到 $p=2n-1$ 系列，局部尺寸支持绝对最大纠缠态。在满足径向定向条件的有限网络上，适当的归一化会产生等距体边界图。

对于两侧满足等距条件的切割，边界熵分解为链接贡献 $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ 和体熵，从而提供量子 Ryu-Takayanagi 结构的离散实现。黑洞内部的应用是通过基于后选择的非等距编码来制定的。假设有额外的哈尔统计数据，该框架用于分析平均重叠的保留以及页面曲线下熵分支之间的竞争。这些结果在LQG的几何自由度和全息码之间建立了建设性的联系，同时阐明了将它们连接到LQG的几何区域、量子极值表面的位置和黑洞蒸发所需的条件。

title: Worldsheet Effective Theory of Abelian-Higgs Cosmic Strings beyond Nambu--Goto
abstract: Cosmic strings can support long-lived excitations confined to their cores, opening channels for energy exchange with the transverse Goldstone modes that describe the string's motion. We derive a covariant worldsheet theory of their coupled dynamics directly from the Abelian-Higgs model at critical coupling, with all interaction coefficients fixed by the microscopic theory. The resulting action, which we validate against numerical lattice field theory simulations, extends the Nambu--Goto description to include a massive scalar shape mode and a massive vector mode. Dualizing the vector reveals a geometric distinction: the shape scalar mode couples to intrinsic worldsheet curvature, while the pseudoscalar couples to normal bundle curvature. These interactions explain the distinct parametric instabilities observed in lattice simulations and predict how the relative polarization of colliding transverse waves controls the excitation of the two internal modes. Our results connect microscopic string structure to the nonlinear worldsheet dynamics, providing a predictive framework for cosmic strings beyond the Nambu--Goto approximation.
summary: 宇宙弦可以支持局限于其核心的长期激发，从而打开与描述弦运动的横向戈德斯通模式进行能量交换的通道。我们直接从临界耦合的阿贝尔-希格斯模型中推导出其耦合动力学的协变世界表理论，所有相互作用系数均由微观理论固定。我们根据数值晶格场论模拟验证了由此产生的作用，它扩展了 Nambu-Goto 描述以包括大量标量形状模式和大量矢量模式。对偶向量揭示了几何区别：形状标量模式与内在世界片曲率耦合，而赝标量与法向丛曲率耦合。这些相互作用解释了在晶格模拟中观察到的明显参数不稳定性，并预测了碰撞横波的相对偏振如何控制两种内部模式的激发。我们的结果将微观弦结构与非线性世界表动力学联系起来，为超出南部-后藤近似的宇宙弦提供了一个预测框架。

title: Equilibrium relativistic spin magnetohydrodynamics from chiral kinetic theory
abstract: We develop a microscopic and thermodynamically consistent framework for relativistic equilibrium spin magnetohydrodynamics of massless chiral fermions, directly from first-order chiral kinetic theory. Starting from the covariant Wigner function, we recast the chiral kinetic equation as a pure streaming equation on a magnetically shifted mass shell, incorporating both the magnetic-moment energy and the Berry-curvature phase-space measure. This formulation yields a kinetic $H$-theorem and an entropy current with vanishing divergence in global equilibrium. We construct the equilibrium distribution for an arbitrary spin frame and derive the associated currents, energy--momentum tensor, spin tensor, entropy current, and frame-independent spin polarization, including the magnetic splitting between particles and antiparticles. Thermodynamic consistency further determines the second-order magnetovortical responses, revealing a relativistic Barnett magnetization, a temperature- and chemical-potential-independent anomalous charge density, and rotation-induced density corrections that reproduce exact field-theory results. Our framework provides a unified microscopic foundation for relativistic equilibrium spin magnetohydrodynamics and establishes a direct link between quantum kinetic theory, spin polarization, magnetization, and anomalous transport.
summary:
我们直接根据一阶手性动力学理论，为无质量手性费米子的相对论平衡自旋磁流体动力学开发了一个微观和热力学一致的框架。从协变维格纳函数开始，我们将手性动力学方程重写为磁移质量壳上的纯流方程，结合了磁矩能量和贝里曲率相空间测量。该公式产生了动力学 $H$ 定理和全局平衡中散度消失的熵流。我们构建了任意自旋框架的平衡分布，并推导了相关的电流、能量动量张量、自旋张量、熵流和与框架无关的自旋极化，包括粒子和反粒子之间的磁分裂。热力学一致性进一步确定了二阶磁涡响应，揭示了相对论性巴尼特磁化强度、与温度和化学势无关的反常电荷密度以及旋转引起的密度校正，从而再现了精确的场论结果。

我们的框架为相对论平衡自旋磁流体动力学提供了统一的微观基础，并在量子动力学理论、自旋极化、磁化和反常输运之间建立了直接联系。

title: Cardinal RG=GR: Phase-Space Cardinality and the Cosmological Constant and Hierarchy Problems
abstract: The effective field theory approach constructs the low-energy theory by integrating out fluctuations above an ultraviolet scale which raises the cosmological constant and hierarchy problems. We investigate an alternative prescription in which the quantum theory is restricted to a finite accessible region of phase space, characterized by a dimensionless cardinality $\mathcal N$, rather than by independently prescribed spacetime and momentum scales. At fixed cardinality these scales are related. For Euclidean de Sitter space, the stationarity condition for the gravitational action can then be written as a stationarity condition with respect to the momentum scale, a relation which we call Cardinal RG=GR. We demonstrate the relation between $\mathcal N$ and the Gibbons-Hawking entropy of de Sitter space, compute the cosmological constant proportional to ${1}/{\sqrt{\mathcal N}}$, show that it is radiatively stable and apply the same prescription to demonstrate the radiative stability of the mass parameter for a simple interacting scalar field model, thereby illuminating the resolution of the hierarchy problem. We also establish a precise limit, involving gravitational data, in which the conventional results of Quantum Field Theory and the Renormalization Group are recovered.
summary:
有效场论方法通过积分紫外线尺度以上的波动来构建低能理论，从而提出了宇宙学常数和层次问题。我们研究了另一种方案，其中量子理论被限制在相空间的有限可访问区域，其特征是无量纲基数 $\mathcal N$，而不是独立规定的时空和动量尺度。在固定基数下，这些尺度是相关的。对于欧几里得德西特空间，引力作用的平稳性条件可以写成相对于动量尺度的平稳性条件，我们将这种关系称为基数 RG=GR。我们证明了 $\mathcal N$ 与德西特空间的吉本斯-霍金熵之间的关系，计算了与 ${1}/{\sqrt{\mathcal N}}$ 成比例的宇宙常数，证明它是辐射稳定的，并应用相同的方法证明了简单相互作用标量场模型的质量参数的辐射稳定性，从而阐明了层次问题的解决。

我们还建立了一个精确的极限，涉及引力数据，其中恢复了量子场论和重正化群的常规结果。

title: Full-Color Two-loop Four-point Form Factor in N=4 SYM with Global CK-duality
abstract: We determine the full-color two-loop four-point MHV form factor of the stress-tensor supermultiplet in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory. Using color-kinematics (CK) duality and unitarity cuts, we construct complete one- and two-loop integrands manifesting global off-shell CK duality without explicit $\mu^2$ dependence. Integration-by-parts reduction to uniform-transcendentality master integrals yields purely rational numbers multiplying simple kinematic prefactors, manifesting maximal transcendentality. Expressing the form factor in terms of pentagon functions, we verify full-color infrared-pole cancellation, extract the finite remainder, and obtain new non-planar results for the two-loop triple-collinear splitting function and double-soft current.
summary: 我们确定了N=4超Yang-Mills理论中应力张量超多重态的全色二环四点MHV形状因子。使用颜色运动学 (CK) 对偶性和幺正性割，我们构造了完整的一环和双环被积函数，表现出全局外壳 CK 对偶性，而没有明确的 $\mu^2$ 依赖性。分部分积分简化为一致超越性主积分产生纯有理数乘以简单的运动学前置因子，表现出最大超越性。用五边形函数表达形状因子，验证全色红外极点抵消，提取有限余数，并获得二环三共线分裂函数和双软电流的新非平面结果。

title: Exact Spherical Branes and Deformations: BMN, IKKT and $\mathcal{N}=2^\ast$
abstract: We present a unified analytic solution to the BPS equations of spherical Dp-branes for $1\leq p \leq 5$ and give the corresponding type II uplifts in closed form. These are holographically dual to maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory on $S^{p+1}$. The change of variables that makes the BPS equations integrable also allows us to analytically calculate a universal result for the holographic Wilson loop and obtain UV asymptotic behaviour previously determined numerically. The same change of variables extends naturally, with suitable modifications, to the cases $p=0$ and $p=-1$. We obtain a 1-parameter family of D0-brane solutions and show how the IR conditions lead to a singular limit of the integration constant. We also solve the D(-1)-brane BPS equations and show the resulting Euclidean uplift fails regularity conditions. Separately, we obtain an explicit representation of the one-ball electrostatic solution of polarised IKKT, which lets us express multipole moments and holographic observables using elliptic invariants. Finally, we analytically solve the BPS equations of the holographic dual of $\mathcal{N}=2^\ast$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory on $S^4$, present the corresponding type IIB uplift and calculate the holographic Wilson loop.
summary:
我们提出了 $1\leq p \leq 5$ 的球形 Dp 膜 BPS 方程的统一解析解，并以封闭形式给出了相应的 II 型隆起。这些是 $S^{p+1}$ 上的最大超对称杨-米尔斯理论的全息对偶。使 BPS 方程可积的变量变化还使我们能够分析计算全息威尔逊环的通用结果，并获得先前通过数值确定的 UV 渐近行为。通过适当的修改，变量的相同变化自然地扩展到 $p=0$ 和 $p=-1$ 的情况。我们获得了 D0 膜解决方案的 1 参数系列，并展示了 IR 条件如何导致积分常数的奇异极限。我们还求解了 D(-1)-膜 BPS 方程，并表明所得到的欧几里德隆升不符合规律性条件。另外，我们获得了偏振 IKKT 的单球静电解的显式表示，这使我们能够使用椭圆不变量来表达多极矩和全息可观测量。

最后，解析求解$S^4$上$\mathcal{N}=2^\ast$超对称Yang-Mills理论的全息对偶BPS方程，给出相应的IIB型隆起并计算全息威尔逊环。

title: All-Order Linearized Hydrodynamics of Charged Holographic Plasmas
abstract: We investigate linearized all-order transport in a finite-density holographic plasma described by five-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory. By retaining the full frequency- and momentum-dependence of the fluid/gravity equations, we determine generalized shear, diffusion, higher-gradient, and chiral-vortical transport functions together with their real-time memory kernels. The different channels exhibit a clear hierarchy of temporal response: the leading shear and diffusion sectors respond promptly, whereas the higher-gradient sectors develop only after a finite buildup time. Remarkably, the chiral-vortical response also shows a finite buildup time despite entering at first order in the hydrodynamic derivative expansion, demonstrating that derivative order does not by itself determine the temporal organization of transport. Toward the near-extremal regime, long-time memory becomes increasingly persistent across several channels. These results reveal how finite density reshapes nonlocal transport and relaxation in strongly coupled holographic plasmas.
summary: 我们研究了五维爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-陈-西蒙斯理论描述的有限密度全息等离子体中的线性全序输运。通过保留流体/重力方程的完整频率和动量依赖性，我们确定了广义剪切、扩散、高梯度和手性涡旋传输函数及其实时存储内核。不同的通道表现出清晰的时间响应层次结构：领先的剪切和扩散部分迅速响应，而较高梯度的部分仅在有限的建立时间后才发展。值得注意的是，尽管在流体动力学导数展开中进入一阶，手性涡旋响应也显示出有限的累积时间，这表明导数阶本身并不决定输运的时间组织。对于近乎极端的状态，长期记忆在多个渠道上变得越来越持久。这些结果揭示了有限密度如何重塑强耦合全息等离子体中的非局域传输和弛豫。

title: Dynamical Temperley-Lieb algebras from Quiver CFTs
abstract: The one-loop dilatation operator of a superconformal planar gauge theory can be written as a sum of local generators. The algebra these generators satisfy is a powerful organising principle for the spectrum. For SU(2)-like bosonic subsectors we show that this algebra can be read off directly from Feynman diagrams, which we identify as a natural graphical language for it. For N=4 super Yang-Mills this simply reproduces the Temperley-Lieb (TL) algebra of the XXX spin chain. After orbifolding and marginally deforming to N=2 superconformal quiver theories, the same recipe yields dynamical generalisations of the TL algebra. In these theories, the faces of the diagrams are coloured according to the quiver nodes, and separated by domain walls corresponding to bifundamental fields. There are two inequivalent SU(2)-like subsectors, which lead to two different TL algebras. One sector is built from the two bifundamental scalars and (in the simplest case) gives a dynamical TL algebra with a colour-dependent loop fugacity in its quadratic relation. The other sector is built from one bifundamental and one adjoint scalar, and (always) gives a novel algebra, in which the cubic TL relation becomes dynamical. In this latter case, we show that each generator of this new algebra is related to a standard XXZ TL generator by a colour-dependent twist. This twist is local and not an algebra homomorphism, and can be written as a dynamical Drinfeld twist. In both sectors, the TL structure provides a natural graphical approach to the spectral problem, as well as clarifying the structure of the irreducible representations of these chains. Finally, we give a preliminary description of the loop models associated to these algebras.
summary:
超共形平面规范理论的单环膨胀算子可以写成局部生成元之和。这些生成器满足的代数是频谱的强大组织原则。对于类似 SU(2) 的玻色子扇区，我们表明该代数可以直接从费曼图读出，我们将其视为自然图形语言。对于 N=4 超级 Yang-Mills，这简单地再现了 XXX 自旋链的 Temperley-Lieb (TL) 代数。在轨道折叠并稍微变形为 N=2 超共形颤动理论之后，相同的方法产生了 TL 代数的动态概括。在这些理论中，图的面根据箭袋节点着色，并由对应于双基场的畴壁分隔。有两个不等价的类 SU(2) 子扇区，从而产生两个不同的 TL 代数。一个扇区由两个双基本标量构建而成，并且（在最简单的情况下）给出了一个动态 TL 代数，其二次关系中具有颜色相关的环逸度。

另一个部分是由一个双基本和一个伴随标量构建的，并且（总是）给出一种新颖的代数，其中三次 TL 关系变得动态。在后一种情况下，我们表明这个新代数的每个生成器都通过颜色相关的扭曲与标准 XXZ TL 生成器相关。这种扭曲是局部的，而不是代数同态，可以写成动态德林菲尔德扭曲。在这两个部分中，TL 结构提供了解决谱问题的自然图形方法，并阐明了这些链的不可约表示的结构。最后，我们给出与这些代数相关的循环模型的初步描述。

title: Black holes and 2-group symmetry from blackfolds in minimal supergravity
abstract: We investigate the black hole phase diagram of five-dimensional minimal supergravity using the blackfold approach and the framework of generalized symmetries. Starting from supergravity coupled to probe sources, we derive the 2-group (non-)conservation laws, construct the equilibrium action for a two-dimensional 2-group fluid, and compute the associated global conserved charges. We then match the thermodynamics of the general non-extremal black string in the ungauged theory to that of this fluid, organizing the blackfold effective theory and its solutions in terms of symmetry invariants. In the non-extremal ungauged sector, we perturbatively construct new black rings, Saturns, di-rings, and bi-rings, including a black Saturn with seven independent parameters. Taking appropriate extremal limits, we identify several extremal branches, some previously unexplored and others anticipated, as well as BPS branches that approximate known supersymmetric families. Finally, we apply the same framework to construct extremal black rings in AdS$_5$, identifying three regular branches that are promising candidates for an exact completion.
summary: 我们使用 Blackfold 方法和广义对称框架研究了五维最小超引力的黑洞相图。从耦合到探测源的超重力开始，我们推导了 2 群（非）守恒定律，构建了二维 2 群流体的平衡作用，并计算了相关的全局守恒电荷。然后，我们将未计量理论中的一般非极值黑弦的热力学与该流体的热力学相匹配，根据对称不变量组织黑折叠有效理论及其解决方案。在非极值未测量区域，我们扰动地构造新的黑环、土星、二环和双环，包括具有七个独立参数的黑土星。采用适当的极值限制，我们确定了几个极值分支，其中一些是以前未探索过的，另一些是预期的，以及近似已知超对称族的 BPS 分支。最后，我们应用相同的框架在 AdS$_5$ 中构建极值黑环，识别出三个有希望实现精确完成的候选分支。

title: Classification of Chern-Simons Couplings and Deformed Pull-Backs on D-Branes
abstract: We establish a framework for classifying higher-derivative Ramond-Ramond (RR) couplings on Dp-branes, focusing on the complete scattering amplitude of a closed-string RR state, a gauge field, and two transverse scalars. The low-energy expansion reveals infinite massless poles and local interaction terms, surpassing standard Myers and Taylor expansions. We propose a higher-class deformation of the pullback using mixed Chern-Simons transgression operators to address these complexities. Our three conjectures are as follows: 1. For fixed field content and derivative order, effective couplings form a finite-dimensional space under stated equivalences. 2. A family of mixed RR, gauge, and scalar interactions exists at all orders, represented by a finite number of effective even forms. 3. The higher-derivative contact-term sector can be constructed from a finite set of basic tensor structures using polynomials in derivative symbols. We introduce a higher-class pullback operator \( P_{\infty} \) and mixed transgression operators \( \mathcal{T}_{\infty} \), emphasizing amplitude-derived pole residues and local contact terms as key physical data. This formalism distinguishes admissible tensor structures, presenting characteristic-form aspects as conjectures alongside their validity considerations.
summary:
我们建立了一个对 Dp 膜上的高导数 Ramond-Ramond (RR) 耦合进行分类的框架，重点关注闭弦 RR 态、规范场和两个横向标量的完整散射振幅。低能展开式揭示了无限无质量极点和局域相互作用项，超越了标准迈尔斯和泰勒展开式。我们提出使用混合 Chern-Simons 海侵算子的更高级别的回调变形来解决这些复杂性。我们的三个猜想如下： 1. 对于固定的场内容和导数阶，有效耦合在规定的等价条件下形成有限维空间。 2. 所有阶数都存在一系列混合 RR、规范和标量相互作用，由有限数量的有效偶数形式表示。 3. 高导数接触项扇区可以使用导数符号中的多项式从一组有限的基本张量结构构造出来。我们引入了更高级别的回拉算子 \( P_{\infty} \) 和混合海侵算子 \( \mathcal{T}_{\infty} \)，强调振幅导出的极点残差和局部接触项作为关键物理数据。

这种形式主义区分了可接受的张量结构，将特征形式方面呈现为猜想以及其有效性考虑。

title: Inhomogeneous Cutoff Regularization of Loops in Cosmological Correlators
abstract: We revisit the use of cutoff regularization in computing loop corrections to cosmological correlators. We argue that a cutoff corresponding to a fixed physical scale must be defined with respect to the local background geometry. In the presence of superhorizon perturbations, this is naturally implemented within the separate universe picture, where different local patches are regulated at the same physical scale. Expanding this cutoff in the long-wavelength background generates a series of regulator-induced contributions to loop amplitudes, which admit a diagrammatic interpretation as long-mode insertions on the corresponding loop contractions. Our cutoff prescription preserves residual spatial dilatations and volume-preserving anisotropic rescalings. It is therefore particularly relevant for loop correlators with soft external modes. We illustrate the mechanism by computing the contributions to the one-loop scalar and tensor power spectra on superhorizon scales. In both cases, the additional corrections induced by the inhomogeneous cutoff cancel the ultraviolet boundary terms arising in the ordinary diagrams. These calculations establish, within cutoff regularization, the late-time constancy of both power spectra and clarify its physical origin. We then investigate the squeezed one-loop scalar bispectrum and show that the additional cutoff contributions are essential for satisfying the consistency relation at finite cutoff. Finally, we discuss the role of the inhomogeneous cutoff in the late-time constancy of the one-loop bispectrum.
summary:
我们重新审视截止正则化在计算宇宙相关器的循环校正中的使用。我们认为，必须根据局部背景几何形状来定义与固定物理尺度相对应的截止值。在存在超地平线扰动的情况下，这自然是在单独的宇宙图景中实现的，其中不同的局部斑块在相同的物理尺度上受到调节。在长波长背景中扩展此截止会产生一系列调节器引起的对环路振幅的贡献，这允许将图解解释为相应环路收缩上的长模式插入。我们的截止处方保留了残余空间扩张和体积保持各向异性重新缩放。因此，它对于具有软外部模式的环路相关器特别重要。我们通过计算超地平线尺度上单环标量和张量功率谱的贡献来说明这一机制。在这两种情况下，由不均匀截止引起的额外校正消除了普通图中出现的紫外线边界项。

这些计算在截止正则化范围内建立了两个功率谱的后期恒定性并阐明了其物理起源。然后，我们研究了压缩的单环标量双谱，并表明额外的截止贡献对于满足有限截止处的一致性关系至关重要。最后，我们讨论了非均匀截止在单环双谱后期恒定性中的作用。

title: Twisting Spinning Particles with Superghost Backgrounds
abstract: We construct twists of spinning particles in the classical BV formalism by giving constant backgrounds to the bosonic ghosts of local worldline supersymmetry, in analogy with Costello and Li's twist of supergravity, which gives a nonzero background to the ghost of local spacetime supersymmetry. We represent the superghosts on polynomial states and gauge selected worldline R symmetries, imposing the shifted R constraints absolutely and the unshifted ones relatively. On flat targets, the N=2 particle, its N=4 extension on a complex target and an N=8 particle with two fermion flavors give the de Rham, Dolbeault and polynomial linear BCOV complexes. The last two are the linearized field content of the open and closed B-model target-space theories. Pairings and interactions require target-space input beyond the reduced worldline differentials.
summary: 我们通过为局域世界线超对称的玻色幽灵提供恒定的背景，在经典 BV 形式主义中构造旋转粒子的扭曲，类似于 Costello 和 Li 的超引力扭曲，它为局域时空超对称的幽灵提供非零背景。我们在多项式状态上表示超级幽灵，并衡量选定的世界线 R 对称性，绝对施加移动的 R 约束，相对地施加未移动的 R 约束。在平面目标上，N=2 粒子、其在复杂目标上的 N=4 扩展以及具有两种费米子风格的 N=8 粒子给出 de Rham、Dolbeault 和多项式线性 BCOV 复合体。最后两个是开放和封闭 B 模型目标空间理论的线性化场内容。配对和交互需要超出减少的世界线差异的目标空间输入。

title: UV Bounds on Inflationary Parity Violation
abstract: A question of fundamental interest is whether parity is violated on large scales in the Universe. This possibility has been motivated by recent analyses of the four-point matter correlation function. It has also been suggested that detectable parity violation could be generated during inflation by the dynamical Chern-Simons operator, a leading effective field theory correction to general relativity. In this work, we examine this possibility in realistic UV completions, including fermionic and string-theoretic examples. We show that existing bounds on the tensor-scalar-scalar (TSS) bispectrum strongly constrain the possibility of generating a detectable parity-odd trispectrum. For tensor-to-scalar ratios near current observational limits, detectability is incompatible with, or pushes against, the regime of validity of these UV completions. A detectable signal can remain possible for a sufficiently small tensor-to-scalar ratio, but only at the cost of an extremely large enhancement of the TSS vertex. Thus, while a future search for large scale parity violation is worth pursuing, generating a detectable signal within a consistent effective theory is highly nontrivial.
summary: 一个根本性的问题是宇宙中的宇称是否在大范围内被违反。这种可能性是由最近对四点物质相关函数的分析激发的。还有人提出，动力陈-西蒙斯算子可以在膨胀过程中产生可检测到的宇称不守恒，这是对广义相对论的一种领先的有效场论修正。在这项工作中，我们在现实的 UV 完成中研究了这种可能性，包括费米子和弦理论的例子。我们表明，张量-标量-标量（TSS）双谱的现有界限强烈限制了生成可检测奇偶三谱的可能性。对于接近当前观测极限的张量与标量比，可探测性与这些 UV 完成的有效性制度不相容或违背。对于足够小的张量与标量比，可检测信号仍然是可能的，但代价是 TSS 顶点的极大增强。因此，虽然未来对大规模奇偶校验破坏的探索值得追求，但在一致有效的理论内生成可检测信号是非常重要的。

title: Equivariant iterated Eisenstein integrals for congruence subgroups of level 2
abstract: The modular properties of holomorphic Eisenstein series for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and its congruence subgroups do not carry over to their primitives. Instead, the transformation of iterated Eisenstein integrals under congruence subgroups of level $N$ introduces inhomogeneous terms comprising (among others) cyclotomic multiple zeta values of level $N$. We combine iterated Eisenstein integrals for the congruence subgroups of level $N=2$ of arbitrary iteration depth with their complex conjugates and (single-valued) level-2 cyclotomic multiple zeta values such that they define non-holomorphic modular forms. Our construction of these so-called equivariant iterated Eisenstein integrals for $\Gamma(2)$ and $\Gamma_0(2)$ proceeds at the level of generating series that take values in an infinite-dimensional (pro-unipotent) Lie group and closely follow Brown's analogous construction in the $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ case. The required insertions of cyclotomic multiple zeta values are controlled by zeta generators for level 2 that normalise the corresponding (pro-nilpotent) Lie algebra of the generating series and whose Lie-bracket relations we determine systematically. Upon restriction to Eisenstein series of modular weight~2, we recover single-valued multiple polylogarithms on the genus 0 modular curve $\Gamma(2)\backslash \mathbb{H}$.
summary:
$\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ 及其同余子群的全纯爱森斯坦级数的模性质不会延续到它们的基元上。相反，迭代爱森斯坦积分在 $N$ 级同余子群下的变换引入了非齐次项，其中包括（除其他外）$N$ 级分圆多重 zeta 值。我们将任意迭代深度的级别 $N=2$ 的同余子群的迭代艾森斯坦积分与其复共轭和（单值）级别 2 分圆多重 zeta 值相结合，以便它们定义非全纯模形式。我们对 $\Gamma(2)$ 和 $\Gamma_0(2)$ 的所谓等变迭代艾森斯坦积分的构造是在生成级数的水平上进行的，该级数取无限维（亲单能）李群中的值，并严格遵循 $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ 情况中布朗的类似构造。分圆多重 zeta 值所需的插入由 2 级 zeta 生成器控制，该生成器对生成级数的相应（亲零能）李代数进行归一化，并且我们系统地确定其李括号关系。

在限制模权重 ~2 的爱森斯坦级数的情况下，我们在属 0 模曲线 $\Gamma(2)\backslash \mathbb{H}$ 上恢复单值多重多对数。

title: Entropy Products and the Extremal Limit That Never Comes
abstract: Two regular black hole horizons need not have an entropy product fixed by the charges and couplings. In Einstein--Maxwell--scalar theory, we construct asymptotically flat branches with products above or below the squared extremal entropy. Regularity selects their horizon scalar values, and different branches can share the charges, couplings, and asymptotic scalar. Each product stays constant as mass and asymptotic scalar vary. The horizon areas stay apart and no extremal limit is reached: the temperature vanishes only where the mass diverges. We prove local existence.
summary: 两个规则的黑洞视界不需要具有由电荷和耦合固定的熵积。在爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量理论中，我们构造渐近平坦分支，其乘积高于或低于平方极值熵。正则性选择它们的水平标量值，不同的分支可以共享电荷、耦合和渐近标量。当质量和渐近标量变化时，每个乘积保持不变。地平线区域保持分开，不会达到极值：只有质量发散的地方温度才会消失。我们证明局部存在。

title: Canonical and Canonoid Transformations of Hamiltonian Systems on $q$-Cosymplectic and $q$-Contact Manifolds
abstract: $q$-Cosymplectic and $q$-contact structures equip presymplectic and precontact geometry with additional one-forms and a normalized family of Reeb vector fields. We study canonical and canonoid transformations relative to these data, with particular attention to their origin in constrained mechanical systems. In the $q$-cosymplectic and uniform $q$-contact cases, we establish local normal forms, characterize infinitesimal automorphisms, and obtain Noether-type relations between symmetries and conserved or dissipated quantities. For a one-parameter group of canonoid transformations with generator $X$, we show that $[X,X_H]$ is Hamiltonian and determine its Hamiltonian function. In the uniform $q$-contact case, simultaneous constant rescalings of the defining forms provide canonoid transformations for every Hamiltonian. The geometric constructions are illustrated by regular relativistic mass-shell constraints and by global Lagrangian descriptions of a charge in magnetic monopole fields. These examples distinguish parameters along constraint orbits from physical time and clarify the role of gauge directions. They also recover the total angular momentum of free relativistic particles and the Poincaré angular momentum of the charge--monopole system. For two monopoles, we construct a non-uniform $2$-contact structure and prove a topological obstruction to a uniform structure with the prescribed gauge generators as Reeb fields. Irrationally related magnetic charges additionally obstruct the intermediate quotient that would produce a single contact manifold. This example identifies a limitation of the uniform theory and motivates its extension to non-uniform structures.
summary:
$q$-共辛和$q$-接触结构为预辛和预接触几何结构配备了额外的一式和归一化的 Reeb 矢量场族。我们研究与这些数据相关的正则和正则变换，特别关注它们在受限机械系统中的起源。在 $q$-共辛和一致 $q$-接触情况下，我们建立局部范式，刻画无穷小自同构，并获得对称性与守恒量或耗散量之间的诺特型关系。对于带有生成器 $X$ 的单参数正则变换组，我们证明 $[X,X_H]$ 是哈密顿量并确定其哈密顿函数。在统一 $q$-接触情况下，定义形式的同时不断重新缩放为每个哈密顿量提供了正则变换。几何结构通过规则相对论质量壳约束和磁单极场中电荷的全局拉格朗日描述来说明。这些示例将约束轨道上的参数与物理时间区分开来，并阐明了规范方向的作用。

他们还恢复了自由相对论粒子的总角动量和电荷单极子系统的庞加莱角动量。对于两个单极子，我们构造了一个非均匀的 $2$ 接触结构，并用规定的规范生成器作为 Reeb 场证明了对均匀结构的拓扑障碍。无理相关的磁荷还会阻碍产生单个接触流形的中间商。这个例子指出了均匀理论的局限性，并促使其扩展到非均匀结构。

title: On Hölder Equicontinuity of the Integrated Density of States for Random Schrödinger Operators on $\mathbb{Z}^d$
abstract: We study a random Schrödinger operator $H_\lambda= H_0 + \lambda V$ on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ consisting of a translation invariant hopping matrix $H_0$ and a random potential $V$, given by independently distributed single site potentials with absolutely continuous distributions. Assuming a regularity assumption for the hopping matrix $H_0$, we show Hölder continuity of the integrated density of states of $H_\lambda$ up to exponents $2/3$, independently of the disorder strength $\lambda$.
summary: 我们研究 $\mathbb{Z}^d$ 上的随机薛定谔算子 $H_\lambda= H_0 + \lambda V$，由平移不变跳跃矩阵 $H_0$ 和随机势 $V$ 组成，由具有绝对连续分布的独立分布的单点势给出。假设跳跃矩阵 $H_0$ 的正则性假设，我们显示 $H_\lambda$ 的积分态密度在指数 $2/3$ 范围内的霍尔德连续性，与无序强度 $\lambda$ 无关。

title: Interacting framework for the free magnetic dynamics
abstract: This is the second paper of a program aimed at a rigorous many--body theory of continuum fermions in a uniform magnetic field, built on the asymptotic quasi--local structure that the magnetic coherent--state frame induces on the CAR algebra. Here we study the free dynamics. We show that a Bogoliubov dynamics preserves the local structure exactly if and only if it is generated by a function of the Landau Hamiltonian. For this class we compute the hopping coefficients in closed form, prove that the Lieb--Robinson velocity vanishes, and determine when the almost--local algebra lies in the domain of the generator. For the Landau Hamiltonian the dynamics turns out to be periodic. We then describe the ground states and the KMS states at every temperature, prove their ergodicity under magnetic translations, and recover the KMS states at positive temperature as thermodynamic limits of local Gibbs states. Finally, we relate the exact hopping operator to the Hofstadter model. These results confirm that the frame--induced local structure is a consistent setting for the perturbed and interacting magnetic dynamics to be studied next.
summary: 这是针对均匀磁场中连续统费米子的严格多体理论的计划的第二篇论文，该理论建立在磁相干态框架在 CAR 代数上诱导的渐近准局域结构的基础上。在这里我们研究自由动力学。我们证明，当且仅当 Bogoliubov 动力学由朗道哈密顿量的函数生成时，它才能准确地保留局部结构。对于此类，我们以封闭形式计算跳跃系数，证明 Lieb-Robinson 速度消失，并确定几乎局部代数何时位于生成器的域中。对于朗道哈密顿量来说，动力学结果是周期性的。然后，我们描述每个温度下的基态和 KMS 态，证明它们在磁平移下的遍历性，并将正温度下的 KMS 态恢复为局部吉布斯态的热力学极限。最后，我们将精确的跳跃算子与 Hofstadter 模型联系起来。这些结果证实，框架引起的局部结构是接下来要研究的扰动和相互作用的磁动力学的一致设置。

title: Painlevé transcendents in the defocusing Hirota equation with non-zero boundary conditions
abstract: We consider the Cauchy problem for the defocusing Hirota equation with non-zero boundary conditions \begin{align*} &iq_t+ q_{xx}-2\left(|q|^2-1\right)q +i\left(q_{xxx}-6|q|^2q_x\right)=0,\\ &q(x,0)=q_0(x)\to\pm 1, \quad x\to\pm\infty, \end{align*} which can be characterized using a Riemann-Hilbert problem through the inverse scattering transform. With the $\bar{\partial}$-steepest descent method and double scaling limit technique, we derive the long-time asymptotics of the solution in two transition regions \begin{align*} \mathcal{P}_{a} :=\left\{(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^{+}: \left| {x}/{t}-a\right|t^{2/3}<C\right\}, \quad a\in\{-4,-8\}, \end{align*} where $C>0$ is a constant. It is shown that the asymptotic expansions in two transition regions can be expressed in terms of the Hastings--McLeod solution of the Painlevé II equation in the generic case and Ablowitz--Segur solutions in the non-generic case.
summary: 我们考虑具有非零边界条件的散焦 Hirota 方程的柯西问题 \begin{align*} &iq_t+ q_{xx}-2\left(|q|^2-1\right)q +i\left(q_{xxx}-6|q|^2q_x\right)=0,\\ &q(x,0)=q_0(x)\to\pm 1, \quad x\to\pm\infty, \end{align*} 可以通过逆散射变换使用黎曼-希尔伯特问题来表征。利用$\bar{\partial}$最速下降法和双尺度极限技术，我们推导出两个过渡区域解的长时渐近性 \begin{align*} \mathcal{P}_{a} :=\left\{(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^{+}: \left| {x}/{t}-a\right|t^{2/3}<C\right\}, \quad a\in\{-4,-8\}, \end{align*} 其中 $C>0$ 是常数。结果表明，两个过渡区域的渐近展开式在一般情况下可以用 Painlevé II 方程的 Hastings--McLeod 解表示，在非一般情况下可以用 Ablowitz--Segur 解来表示。

title: Semiclassical Averaging and Temporal Fluctuations of Quantum Dark Solitons in the Lieb-Liniger Model
abstract: We study the time evolution of quantum dark-soliton states of the Lieb--Liniger model, introduced by Sato--Kanamoto--Kaminishi--Deguchi as equal-weight superpositions of one-hole yrast states, and their relation to Gross--Pitaevskii (GP) solitons. We consider a simultaneous weak-coupling and large-system limit in which the repulsive coupling constant $c$ tends to zero and the particle number $N$ and ring circumference $L$ tend to infinity, with the mean density $\bar n=N/L$ and scaled circumference $\Lambda=L\sqrt{c\bar n}$ fixed. We conjecture that, in this limit, the normalized quantum density and its evolution at fixed scaled time $\tau=c\bar n t$ are described by a canonical-momentum average of normalized periodic one-soliton GP densities, each evolving at its own velocity. We explicitly parametrize the GP family by canonical momentum and provide numerical evidence for this correspondence. The different velocities explain the spreading of the averaged density notch despite shape preservation by individual solitons. In the infinite-line limit, we derive an analytic expression for the initial averaged profile, establish an inverse-fifth-power decay of its density deficit with distance from the soliton center, and express the Fourier transform of its deviation from the background as a series of Bickley--Naylor functions $\operatorname{Ki}_3$. Following the spreading of the initial notch, we investigate temporal density fluctuations of the quantum dark solitons and propose a relation between long-time mode variances and second moments of GP Fourier coefficients, supported by numerical comparisons of individual mode variances and the total variance. Yrast transition frequencies distinguish the initial dephasing time scale from the longer scale associated with finite-time averaging of fluctuations.
summary:
我们研究 Lieb-Liniger 模型的量子暗孤子态的时间演化，该模型由 Sato-Kanamoto-Kaminishi-Deguchi 作为单空穴 yrast 态的等权叠加引入，以及它们与 Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) 孤子的关系。我们考虑弱耦合和大系统同时极限，其中排斥耦合常数 $c$ 趋于零，粒子数 $N$ 和环周长 $L$ 趋于无穷大，平均密度 $\bar n=N/L$ 和缩放周长 $\Lambda=L\sqrt{c\bar n}$ 固定。我们推测，在这个极限下，归一化量子密度及其在固定缩放时间 $\tau=c\bar n t$ 的演化是由归一化周期单孤子 GP 密度的规范动量平均值来描述的，每个密度都以自己的速度演化。我们通过规范动量明确地对 GP 族进行参数化，并为这种对应关系提供了数值证据。尽管单个孤子保持了形状，但不同的速度解释了平均密度凹口的扩散。

在无限线极限下，我们推导了初始平均轮廓的解析表达式，建立了其密度赤字随距孤子中心距离的五次方倒数衰减，并将其与背景的偏差的傅立叶变换表示为一系列 Bickley-Naylor 函数 $\operatorname{Ki}_3$。随着初始陷波的扩展，我们研究了量子暗孤子的时间密度涨落，并提出了长时模式方差和 GP 傅里叶系数的二阶矩之间的关系，并得到了单个模式方差和总方差的数值比较的支持。 Yrast 转变频率将初始相移时间尺度与与波动的有限时间平均相关的较长尺度区分开来。

title: A Faà di Bruno Convolution Identity in Parafermion Operator Products
abstract: We give a detailed combinatorial proof of a Faà di Bruno convolution identity used in parafermion operator-product calculations. The identity establishes the cancellation of potentially more singular terms and shows that the leading contribution combines the polynomial indices additively. The proof, originating in the author's doctoral thesis, provides a general derivation of an identity stated in earlier parafermion literature.
summary: 我们给出了在平费米子算子乘积计算中使用的 Faà di Bruno 卷积恒等式的详细组合证明。该恒等式建立了潜在更多奇异项的取消，并表明主要贡献相加地结合了多项式指数。该证明源自作者的博士论文，提供了早期平费米子文献中所述恒等式的一般推导。

title: Block decimation and perfect actions for $p$-adic valued path integrals
abstract: In earlier work we introduced a finite-partition propagator for $\mathbb{C}_p$-valued wave functions, in which the intermediate positions are integrated against atomic measures. The iterated integral evaluates the action on the equally spaced chain between the endpoints, so each partition level is obtained by iterating an exact, tree-level block decimation of two-point lattice actions, with no integration over fluctuations. This kinematic decimation is the Fréchet derivative, at the free actions, of the variational decimation underlying classical perfect actions. Since the time step $p^n$ is small in the real norm exactly when it is large $p$-adically, refinement and coarsening (the ultraviolet and infrared directions over $\mathbb{R}$) exchange roles, and each yields one limit. Under refinement, potentials supported on $\mathbb{Z}_p$, given there by a convergent power series, and entering the slice action without the time-step weight produce an interaction that stabilizes off the diagonal after finitely many steps and converges uniformly on $\mathbb{Z}_p^2$, with sharp error $p^{-M}$ after $M$ steps, to a scale-covariant (perfect) action, governed near the diagonal by a Volkenborn integral; with the weight no limit exists. For the harmonic oscillator no refinement limit exists at fixed frequency, but under coarsening the variational flow is solved in closed form: the lattice angle is multiplied by $p$ at each step, the coupling obeys a Chebyshev recursion, no caustic occurs, and the rescaled action converges to a free action with renormalized mass $m_0\sin_p(\theta_0)/\theta_0$. The rescaled linearized map is diagonalizable on polynomial actions with eigenvalues $p^{2-b}$, so directions relevant over $\mathbb{R}$ are irrelevant over $\mathbb{Q}_p$ and conversely.
summary:
在早期的工作中，我们引入了 $\mathbb{C}_p$ 值波函数的有限分区传播器，其中中间位置针对原子测量进行积分。迭代积分评估端点之间等距链上的动作，因此每个分区级别都是通过迭代两点晶格动作的精确树级块抽取来获得的，而不对波动进行积分。这种运动学抽取是自由动作下经典完美动作下的变分抽取的 Fréchet 导数。由于时间步长 $p^n$ 在实数范数中很小，而当它很大时，细化和粗化（$\mathbb{R}$ 上的紫外线和红外线方向）交换角色，并且每种都会产生一个极限。

在细化过程中，$\mathbb{Z}_p$上支持的势，由收敛幂级数给出，并在没有时间步长权重的情况下进入切片动作，产生一种相互作用，在有限多个步骤后稳定对角线，并均匀收敛于$\mathbb{Z}_p^2$，在$M$步后出现尖锐误差$p^{-M}$，达到尺度协变（完美）动作，由Volkenborn积分控制对角线附近；重量没有限制。对于谐振子，在固定频率下不存在细化极限，但在粗化下，变分流以封闭形式求解：晶格角在每一步乘以 $p$，耦合遵循切比雪夫递归，不会发生焦散，并且重新缩放的作用收敛到具有重新归一化质量 $m_0\sin_p(\theta_0)/\theta_0$ 的自由作用。重新缩放的线性化映射在具有特征值 $p^{2-b}$ 的多项式作用上可对角化，因此与 $\mathbb{R}$ 相关的方向与 $\mathbb{Q}_p$ 无关，反之亦然。

title: Scaling limits for products of induced symplectic Ginibre matrices
abstract: We study the local eigenvalue correlations of products of independent induced symplectic Ginibre matrices in the large-dimensional limit. We establish the scaling limits of the correlation functions in the bulk, at the spectral edges, and outside the limiting spectral support, both near and away from the real axis. At regular spectral points, we show that the limiting correlations coincide with those of a single symplectic Ginibre ensemble, exhibiting Pfaffian structures near the real axis and determinantal structures away from it. At the origin, where the limiting spectral density develops a singularity, we derive an integral representation of the parameter-dependent limiting Pfaffian prekernel. Our proofs are based on a unified approach involving a differential equation for the skew prekernels and their asymptotics.
summary: 我们研究了大维极限下独立诱导辛 Ginibre 矩阵乘积的局部特征值相关性。我们在整体、光谱边缘和限制光谱支持之外（靠近和远离实轴）建立了相关函数的缩放限制。在规则谱点，我们表明限制相关性与单个辛吉尼布系综的限制相关性一致，在实轴附近表现出普法夫结构，在远离实轴时表现出行列式结构。在极限谱密度产生奇点的原点，我们推导了参数相关的极限普法夫前核的积分表示。我们的证明基于一种统一的方法，涉及偏斜预核及其渐近的微分方程。

title: Root-of-Unity Limits of Trigonometric qKZ Connections
abstract: Over the field of complex numbers, we study root-of-unity limits of trigonometric qKZ connections associated with tensor products of $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ Verma modules and of their hypergeometric solutions. As the multiplicative step approaches a primitive $m$-th root of unity and the quantum-group and twist parameters approach $1$, the $m$-step qKZ transport yields, on every fixed-degree subspace,a differential connection. We show that this connection is the pullback of the trigonometric KZ connection under the power map $z\mapsto z^m$, with the KZ parameter rescaled by $m$, and establish formal and $\ell$-adic versions. In degree one, with all highest weights equal to $1$, we determine the limits of normalized qKZ hypergeometric circle integrals in arbitrary angular chambers. The limits are expressed in terms of loaded hypergeometric integrals for the trigonometric KZ equations and explicit chamber-dependent upper-triangular matrices. We establish compatibility of the resulting distinguished fundamental matrices under inward analytic continuation, governed by the right weak Bruhat order,and under power maps, including composition of root orders.
summary: 在复数领域，我们研究与 $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ Verma 模及其超几何解的张量积相关的三角 qKZ 连接的单位根极限。当乘法步骤接近原 $m$ 单位根并且量子群和扭曲参数接近 $1$ 时，$m$ 步 qKZ 传输在每个固定度子空间上产生微分连接。我们证明这个连接是功率映射 $z\mapsto z^m$​​ 下三角 KZ 连接的回拉，KZ 参数按 $m$ 重新缩放，并建立正式版本和 $\ell$-adic 版本。在一级，所有最高权重等于 $1$，我们确定任意角室中归一化 qKZ 超几何圆积分的极限。这些限制以三角 KZ 方程的加载超几何积分和显式依赖于室的上三角矩阵表示。我们在由右弱 Bruhat 阶控制的内向解析延拓下以及在幂映射下（包括根阶的组成）建立了所得到的区分基本矩阵的兼容性。

title: Curvature Integrability in Twinor Theory: An Ambitwistor Approach to the Twinor Googly Problem
abstract: The twinor analogue of the googly problem is addressed through an ambitwistor structure defined by null autoparallels, retaining both chiralities, sources and torsion without requiring chiral null surfaces. Under the stated quotient, evaluation and descent assumptions, holomorphic affine sections reconstruct the twinor field equation $DY=J$. Correspondence-space cohomology realizes the contracted chiral and ladder equations, including the ladder's soldering coupling and mass-normalization source. For a prescribed non-normal conformal connection, infinity-twistor parallelism recovers the energy--momentum equation, supplemented by independent spin-current equations. These constructions give a conditional auxiliary formulation; constitutive sources and gravitational prescriptions remain dynamical input.
summary: 谷歌问题的孪生类似物通过由零自平行定义的双向扭转结构得到解决，保留手性、源和挠率，而不需要手性零表面。在规定的商、评估和下降假设下，全纯仿射部分重建孪生场方程 $DY=J$。对应空间上同调实现了收缩的手性方程和梯子方程，包括梯子的焊接耦合和质量归一化源。对于规定的非正态共形连接，无限扭转并行性恢复了能量动量方程，并辅以独​​立的自旋电流方程。这些结构给出了有条件的辅助公式；本构源和引力规定仍然是动态输入。

title: Entanglement Geometry Beyond Polygons: Graph-Theoretic Entanglement Inequalities
abstract: Entanglement entropies of pure multipartite states can be constrained by organizing subsystem cuts as edges (hyperedges) of graphs (hypergraphs). Starting from the one-party entanglement polygon inequality, we derive these constraints from strong subadditivity and pure-state complementarity, with optimal coefficients and explicit equality conditions. Our central result determines, for a distinguished two-party cut and an arbitrary weighted family of cuts, the optimal polygon coefficient: the smallest total weight of the cuts separating a member of the distinguished pair from a remaining party. A refinement involving three mutual information terms gives the exact minimum of the weighted sum at fixed entropies of the two parties and of their union, attained by at most three independent bipartite pure states. This criterion recovers the cycle and complete-graph inequalities and shows that uniform incidence parity, which we prove sufficient for polygon inequalities on hypergraphs, is not necessary. Averaging strong subadditivity over both sides of a bipartition gives a sharp $k$-marginal inequality with coefficient $2\binom{n-2}{k-1}$, and we determine uniformly optimal coefficients for collective hyperstar inequalities. For paths and overlapping hyperchains, the deficits are exact sums of conditional mutual information terms; genuinely multipartite entangled cluster states saturate the hyperchain inequality while the chain inequality remains strict. We characterize pure chain equality states, bound the trace distance to cycle equality states independently of the number of parties and local dimensions, and obtain bond-dimension bounds for matrix product states and sequential-recovery error estimates.
summary:
纯多部分态的纠缠熵可以通过将子系统切割组织为图（超图）的边（超边）来约束。从单方纠缠多边形不等式开始，我们从强次可加性和纯态互补性以及最优系数和显式等式条件中推导出这些约束。我们的中心结果确定了，对于区分的两方切割和任意加权的切割族，最佳多边形系数：将区分对的成员与剩余方分开的切割的最小总权重。涉及三个互信息项的细化给出了最多三个独立的二分纯态在两方及其联合的固定熵下的加权和的精确最小值。该标准恢复了循环和完全图不等式，并表明均匀关联奇偶性（我们证明对于超图上的多边形不等式来说足够）并不是必需的。

对二分两侧的强次可加性进行平均，给出了系数为 $2\binom{n-2}{k-1}$ 的尖锐 $k$ 边际不等式，并且我们确定了集体超星不等式的统一最优系数。对于路径和重叠超链，赤字是条件互信息项的精确总和；真正的多部分纠缠簇状态使超链不等式饱和，而链不等式仍然严格。我们描述了纯链平等状态，将跟踪距离限制为独立于参与方数量和局部维度的循环平等状态，并获得矩阵乘积状态和顺序恢复误差估计的键维度界限。

title: The Clifford Hierarchy from Clifford Stabilizers in 2D
abstract: The Bravyi-König theorem limits the constant-depth logical gates of 2D topological Pauli stabilizer codes to be in the Clifford group. Known qubit codes with Clifford stabilizers exceed it by only one level of the Clifford hierarchy, and this was conjectured to hold generally. We show that this bound can be completely bypassed, and that topological codes with Clifford stabilizers in 2D can realize transversal logical gates at any level of the Clifford hierarchy. We present two explicit constructions of codes based on copies of the quantum doubles of $D_4$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2$, with $k$ logical qubits and a logical $C^{k-1}Z$ gate, which is at level $k$ of the Clifford hierarchy. The physical circuits realizing the gates consist only of physical $Z$ or $CZ$ gates. The main new ingredient comes from the logical encoding, which depends crucially on non-Abelian group multiplication.
summary: Bravyi-König 定理将二维拓扑泡利稳定器码的恒定深度逻辑门限制在 Clifford 群中。已知的具有 Clifford 稳定器的量子位代码仅超出 Clifford 层次结构的一级，并且这被推测普遍成立。我们证明这个界限可以完全绕过，并且具有二维 Clifford 稳定器的拓扑代码可以在 Clifford 层次结构的任何级别实现横向逻辑门。我们提出了两种基于 $D_4$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 量子双精度副本的显式代码构造，具有 $k$ 个逻辑量子位和一个逻辑 $C^{k-1}Z$ 门，位于 Clifford 层次结构的 $k$ 级。实现门的物理电路仅由物理 $Z$ 或 $CZ$ 门组成。主要的新成分来自逻辑编码，这在很大程度上取决于非阿贝尔群乘法。

title: Birthday-Scale Non-Adaptive Security for Strong Pseudorandom Unitaries
abstract: Pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs) are efficiently implementable unitary ensembles that are computationally indistinguishable from Haar-random unitaries, providing efficient substitutes for Haar-randomness in quantum information and cryptography. Strong PRUs require this indistinguishability to hold even when the adversary is given access to all of $U$, $U^\dagger$, $U^*$, and $U^T$. In this work, we prove birthday-scale non-adaptive security for the DPFC (Clifford-Phase-Permutation-Clifford) strong PRU candidate. For an $N$-dimensional unitary, allowing arbitrary entangled inputs and coherent superpositions of query types, we show that DPFC can withstand $t \approx \sqrt{N}$ queries. This matches the best known query complexity even for PRUs that are not strong, compared with $t \approx N^\alpha$ for $\alpha < 1/2$ in previous strong-PRU analyses. Our proof utilizes two techniques from previous works: the EPR-sector decomposition of Schuster et al. (arXiv 2025), previously used for unitary designs but not for PRUs, and the path-recording framework of Ma and Huang (STOC 2025), previously used for adaptive security analysis. We complement the non-adaptive security result with an upper bound in the adaptive setting, showing that DPFC cannot remain secure for $t \gg \sqrt{N}$ queries.
summary:
伪随机酉 (PRU) 是可有效实现的酉系综，在计算上与哈尔随机酉系综无法区分，为量子信息和密码学中的哈尔随机性提供了有效的替代品。即使对手有权访问所有 $U$、$U^\dagger$、$U^*$ 和 $U^T$，强 PRU 也需要保持这种不可区分性。在这项工作中，我们证明了 DPFC（Clifford-Phase-Permutation-Clifford）强 PRU 候选者的生日规模非自适应安全性。对于 $N$ 维酉，允许任意纠缠输入和查询类型的连贯叠加，我们表明 DPFC 可以承受 $t \approx \sqrt{N}$ 查询。与之前强 PRU 分析中 $\alpha < 1/2$ 的 $t \approx N^\alpha$ 相比，即使对于不强的 PRU，这也符合最著名的查询复杂性。我们的证明利用了之前作品中的两种技术：Schuster 等人的 EPR 扇区分解。 (arXiv 2025)，以前用于单一设计，但不适用于 PRU，而 Ma 和 Huang 的路径记录框架 (STOC 2025)，以前用于自适应安全分析。

我们用自适应设置中的上限来补充非自适应安全结果，表明 DPFC 无法保持 $t \gg \sqrt{N}$ 查询的安全。

title: A Basis-Dependent Kernel for Learning Quantum Phases of Matter
abstract: Identifying the phases of a quantum many-body system as its parameters vary is a central problem in condensed-matter physics. Data-driven approaches address this task by comparing quantum states, for instance through their fidelity, and locating transitions where these comparisons change abruptly. In this work, we introduce the inverse participation ratio (IPR) kernel, a kernel method built for learning quantum phases of matter from IPRs in physically motivated bases.
